messages:
jc_hansen (Acme): Hey team — since the model bump yesterday (we think you moved our workspace to redwood-2.2) we've seen replies get noticeably shorter and a bit...less explanatory. Not an error, but support agents tell me customers are asking follow-ups because answers lack the previous level of detail.

jc_hansen (Acme): Example (redacted):
```
User: How do I reset my API key?
Assistant (before): To rotate your API key, go to Account > API keys, click Rotate, then update any services using the old key. It may take up to 2 minutes to propagate. If you have long-lived services, consider using a secondary key and a rolling deployment.

Assistant (after): Go to Account > API keys and rotate it.
```

jc_hansen (Acme): The shortened reply triggers extra support tickets. Can you confirm if there was a behavior change or new system prompt?

Alex (support): thanks for the report — sorry about the regressions, jc. quick questions: which workspace/org id? can you paste 2–3 conversation examples (full request payload + assistant output) and the request_id header from our responses?

Maria (support): Also, what model + params were in your calls (model param, temperature, max_tokens, top_p, system prompt if used)? We rolled a patch yesterday but need to confirm tenant routing. :mag:

jc_hansen (Acme): org: acme-inc-42. One example pasted below (removed attachments). Request header x-request-id: 8f3b2a7c. model param we used: redwood-2.2, temperature: 0.2, max_tokens: 512. system prompt is our product_support_prompt_v3 (attached in ticket).

jc_hansen (Acme): Full request (sanitized):
```json
{
  "model":"redwood-2.2",
  "messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful support assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"How do I reset my API key?"}],
  "temperature":0.2,
  "max_tokens":512
}
```

Alex (support): perfect, thanks. I created a support ticket and attached your payload — ticket SR-4591. Support Bot — can you log this SR and notify eng-ml?

Support Bot: Created ticket SR-4591. Priority: P2. Notifying #eng-ml.

Lee (eng-ml): looping in eng-ml. can you also share a few statistical deltas if possible (avg tokens per response before vs after, fraction of responses < 30 tokens, any recent rollout notes). we did a model variant swap for some tenants yesterday at 03:15 UTC but that shouldn't have changed system-level verbosity. we'll run a quick eval on your prompt set.

Maria (support): repro steps for us to triage quickly: 1) Send 3 examples (full JSON requests + x-request-id). 2) Confirm whether you use streaming. 3) If you have a saved eval set that showed expected verbosity, attach it. we'll compare outputs from redwood-2.1 vs redwood-2.2.

jc_hansen (Acme): sending two more examples in the ticket; we do NOT use streaming. note: no change to client-side truncation or UI.

Alex (support): thanks — we're escalating to an ML sweep. initial ask from eng-ml: can you confirm whether the system prompt contains explicit verbosity constraints ("be concise" etc.)? if so, please attach versions.

jc_hansen (Acme): our system prompt is long and neutral — does not instruct conciseness. attached in SR. appreciate the quick help.

Lee (eng-ml): quick update — we've queued a diff run: sample your three examples against redwood-2.1 and redwood-2.2, compute mean tokens, and run a simple ROUGE-L on the assistant outputs to highlight missing explanatory content. will post results in the SR.

Alex (support): small workaround while we investigate: try bumping max_tokens to a higher value or set explicit "assistant_instructions" in system prompt (e.g., "When possible provide step-by-step guidance and short examples.") — this is a temporary measure.

jc_hansen (Acme): thanks — we'll try the system prompt tweak and report back. appreciate the escalation. :pray:

Support Bot: SR-4591 updated: eng-ml assigned (Lee).

Alex (support): keeping this thread open. if you see any regressions in tone elsewhere, please ping us.

jc_hansen (Acme): will do. thanks all!
